name: Three Pot
short_description: Runs DSP code from the SD card
description: This algorithm allows you to run what are effectively DSP "plug-ins", loaded from the MicroSD card. It was designed particularly to support programs written for the Spin Semiconductor FV-1 chip. Although the focus is on converted FV-1 programs, the conversion works by translating the programs to C++ and then compiling them for the disting NT – so you can if you like actually write C++ directly and use this algorithm to run it on the module.
use_cases: Running FV-1 DSP programs converted to 3pot format
Running custom C++ DSP code on the disting NT
Using open source Spin Semiconductor DSP programs
gui_description: The UI provides a custom display showing the program name, pot labels, and description (all from the 3pot file if provided). The three physical pots on the module control the three pot parameters directly. The right encoder changes the program. While selecting a new program, the whole display is given over to showing the program description.

parameters.name: Pre/post gain
parameters.description: Sets the gain adjustment applied before the program’s DSP code. See above.

parameters.name: Mix style
parameters.description: Chooses the dry/wet mix style: ‘None’, ‘Wet/dry’, or ‘Independent’.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Sets the mix if the style is ‘Wet/dry’.

parameters.name: Dry gain
parameters.description: Sets the dry gain if the mix style is ‘Independent’.

parameters.name: Wet gain
parameters.description: Sets the wet gain if the mix style is ‘Independent’.

parameters.name: Sample rate
parameters.description: The sample rate (in kHz) at which to run the program.

parameters.name: Output mode
parameters.description: The standard Add/Replace mode selector as described above.
